name: rook-ops
description: The operator's services (docs/v6/p1-services.md): the runner that calls the canister's tick on a schedule (K4, the only holder of the operator's hot IC identity, read in src/identity.ts), the offer tool that turns a venue's listing into frog_offer with every check the canister makes (K4, dry run by default), and the hourly reserves reconciliation with its alert (K7, no key). Two images, two entrypoints.
